title: Traits
summary: Pick one at each level-up. Ordinary traits can be taken again; unique ones once per run. Higher phases are stronger but rarer.

sections.title: Trait list
sections.note: Weight is how likely the trait is against the others of its phase. "From Lv" is the character level it can first appear at.
